entities.summary: Habib Muhammedovich Abdullayev was a Soviet-Uzbek geologist and politician who led the Academy of Sciences of the Uzbek SSR from 1956 to 1962 and served as chairman of the Council of Ministers of the Uzbek SSR. His son, Pulat Abdullayev, became a diplomat.
